zh.text: 宇宙配置增补服务端 261125.3 新增的 AIR 学院舰船开关：可在「玩法 / 学院舰船」中控制飞行员借用学院舰船；修改后需重启服务端与客户端生效。
新增配置的中文名称与英语、日语、韩语、法语、德语、荷兰语、俄语界面翻译已同步补齐。

en.text: Universe Config now includes the AIR Academy Ships toggle added in server 261125.3, under Gameplay / Academy Ships, controlling whether pilots can borrow academy ships. Restart both the server and client after changing it.
The new setting is localized in English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Dutch and Russian.
